groups.name: desktop primary C# source enumeration
groups.rationale: contractIntegrity.test.ts:37-42 enumerates all top-level .cs files and counts their lines;18 selected source files cannot stand in for the204-file directory.

groups.name: behavior contract directory
groups.rationale: contractIntegrity.test.ts:31-34 enumerates, sorts and reads every top-level .contract.md; directory membership is part of the input.

groups.name: release/completion reference data
groups.rationale: Frozen releaseCertification.test.ts:270,393,707-760 and completionRegister.test.ts:30 use current retained references; absence handling is an assertion input, not an excuse to bypass a read.

groups.name: deployment files
groups.rationale: einvoiceProductionGuard.test.ts:102-132 reads these exact files. .env.example was omitted and a stale Git-baseline copy remained; capture bytes without emitting any environment contents.

groups.name: release workflow text
groups.rationale: releaseCertification.test.ts:609-695 reads both active root and historical nested CI/release workflow copies and compares semantics.

groups.name: web source read by API assertions
groups.rationale: releaseCertification.test.ts:448 reads the actual journey producer. pageEndpointFamily.test.ts:24-26,30-94 reads the shared component and five transaction pages.

groups.name: completion-register declared page existence
groups.rationale: completionRegister.test.ts:72-75 tests existsSync/statSync for every declared page surface; exact page claims and filesystem presence must be reproducible.

groups.name: API source scanned as data
groups.rationale: postingAccountLiterals.test.ts recursively reads API TypeScript; kernelConformance.test.ts does the same; routePolicy/routeInputForwarding also read specific API source files.

groups.name: core source scanned as data
groups.rationale: kernelConformance.test.ts:35-54 scans every core TypeScript source, independently of compiled imports; preserve frozen membership, not unrelated new active files.

groups.name: report specification data
groups.rationale: reportContract.test.ts:252-293 reads all .spec.json plus schema; reportEngine loads named .spec.json and report-layouts-index.json or falls back to directory enumeration.

groups.name: form specification data
groups.rationale: formLayoutEngine.ts:24-61 loads name variants and enumerates all JSON files when called by the API; include all captured176 spec files and preserve membership.

groups.name: schema and cross-package literal fixtures
groups.rationale: reportContract.test.ts reads Prisma schema; saleReturnIncomingConfiguration.review.test.ts:30-39 hashes/reads both core golden files directly.

groups.name: script modules imported by tests
groups.rationale: Test imports exercise script helper functions. load-profile creates require relative to API package.json. secret-scanner uses TypeScript package dependency. Release identity uses synthetic files/injected Git, not live source checkout files.

groups.name: API-local fixture data and helpers
groups.rationale: Direct readFile/new URL and JSON imports in image, configuration, source, replay and ledger tests; complete fixture membership remains captured.

limitations: Static source/import and current directory membership audit, not system-call tracing.
Node modules/generated Prisma/current built package outputs remain governed by the dependency/build capture, not duplicated into this external-reference appendix.
Frozen assertions are authoritative; active existsSync-based bypasses are not adopted.
